Qt Artifacts Shipped with MyWB
==============================

This file identifies the Qt artifacts observed in the current MyWB macOS
standalone app bundle. It is an inventory of shipped Qt files, not a complete
copy of the upstream Qt third-party notices.

Bundled Qt version: 6.11.1

Full Qt third-party notices for Qt 6.11 are published by The Qt Company at:
https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/licenses-used-in-qt.html

Only Qt artifacts actually shipped with MyWB apply to this release. Platform-
specific upstream notices for Qt components that are not present in this app
bundle, such as Windows D3D/Wintab components or X11/XCB components, are not
included in this inventory.

Python Binding Modules
----------------------

- PySide6/QtCore.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtDBus.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtGui.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtOpenGL.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtOpenGLWidgets.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtSvg.abi3.so
- PySide6/QtWidgets.abi3.so

Qt Frameworks
-------------

- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtCore.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtDBus.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtGui.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtOpenGL.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtOpenGLWidgets.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtSvg.framework
- PySide6/Qt/lib/QtWidgets.framework

Qt Framework Symlinks
---------------------

- QtCore
- QtDBus
- QtGui
- QtOpenGL
- QtOpenGLWidgets
- QtSvg
- QtWidgets

Qt Plugins
----------

Icon engines:
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/iconengines/libqsvgicon.dylib

Image formats:
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqgif.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqicns.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqico.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqjpeg.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqmacheif.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqmacjp2.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqsvg.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqtga.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqtiff.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqwbmp.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/imageformats/libqwebp.dylib

Platform plugins:
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/platforms/libqcocoa.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/platforms/libqminimal.dylib
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/platforms/libqoffscreen.dylib

Styles:
- PySide6/Qt/plugins/styles/libqmacstyle.dylib

Relevant Upstream Notice Areas
------------------------------

The shipped artifacts above correspond primarily to the Qt Core, Qt D-Bus,
Qt GUI, Qt OpenGL, Qt SVG, and Qt Widgets upstream notice areas. The bundled
image format plugins may also correspond to upstream Qt image-format notice
areas such as JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, SVG, and macOS-specific image handlers.

Excluded Qt Areas
-----------------

The current MyWB standalone build excludes Qt Network, Qt PDF, Qt QML,
Qt Quick, Qt Test, and Qt Virtual Keyboard Python modules and plugins.
